title: Modern decor may be straining people's brains
summary: A popular science article discussing how modern minimalist interior design with clean lines, neutral colors, and sparse decoration may overstimulate or strain the brain due to lack of visual interest and environmental complexity compared to traditional or nature-inspired spaces.
problem_solved: Explores the potential psychological impact of contemporary home design on cognitive comfort and well-being.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about the connection between environmental design and mental health, offering insights for interior design choices.
